subject: spanish

moments.title: First flamenco cafes
moments.body: 'Cafes cantantes' bring flamenco from private events into public performance.
moments.takeaway: Folk traditions become public art forms through specific venues.

moments.title: Concurso de Cante Jondo
moments.who: Manuel de Falla and Federico Garcia Lorca, Granada
moments.body: Falla and Lorca organise a flamenco festival to preserve the tradition's depth.
moments.takeaway: Cultural figures rescue traditions from commodification.

moments.title: Flamenco named UNESCO heritage
moments.body: Flamenco is inscribed on the list of Intangible Cultural Heritage.

now.title: Flamenco today
now.body: Rosalia's fusion of flamenco with pop reaches global audiences. Traditional festivals continue in Andalusia.
now.open_questions: Where does fusion end and tradition begin?

reflection: Flamenco belongs to Roma communities, Andalusia and the world simultaneously.
